sections.Profile:
"Minstrel Man" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1951. Designed by Harry Mabs, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two kick-out holes, and three drop targets—the first use of drop targets in a Gottlieb machine.
